messages:
ana-partnerships: FYI — EdgeScale wants to move from hourly appliance exports to per-minute (they suggested per-second events) and asked for a migration window + recon plan.

sam-engineering: Clarifying q: new event schema or same schema with different unit on `usage_minutes`?

ana-partnerships: They sent a sample. They propose a `usage_seconds` field and to stop hourly aggregates.

ana-partnerships: ```json
{
  "device_id": "edge-1234",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T14:12:00Z",
  "usage_seconds": 120,
  "sku_id": "redwood.edge.small"
}
```

sam-engineering: Ingest change required. Options: convert to canonical minutes at ingress or adopt seconds internally. Backfill plan: accept both schemas for 30 days, run backfill for last 90 days on request. Rough estimate: 2 dev days + 1 day infra. Need feature flag + canary.

jess-devex: We should provide a partner sandbox with replay + golden files, and docs showing idempotency behavior. Also sample payloads and replay script.

katie-sre: Ops notes: add `idempotency_key` to schema. Recommend per-partner rate limits and ingestion dashboard (p95 latency, dup rate). Backfill must be throttled.

marc-legal: Heads up: changing billing unit may affect revenue recognition and contracts. We need an amendment specifying proration, effective date, and notice. I'll draft language when dates are final.

ana-partnerships: Partner proposes migration start 2026-04-05 and stop hourly exports 2026-04-12 (two-week window). Thoughts?

sam-engineering: Tight but doable if parallelized. Limit initial rollout to 10 devices for canary. I'll post deployment plan later today.

jess-devex: I'll build sandbox and docs by EOD tomorrow. Sample mapping CSV we'll include.

partners-bot: ACTION_CREATED: onboarding-ticket #PRT-1842 assigned to sam-engineering. Checklist: schema-support, sandbox, backfill-plan, billing-sig, legal-approval.

ana-partnerships: Action items: (1) sam scope + estimate today, (2) jess sandbox + docs by EOD tomorrow, (3) marc amendment by Fri, (4) katie monitoring and rate limits. I'll update partner after signoffs.

sam-engineering: For backfill we'll aggregate seconds -> minute buckets server-side and prefer partner minute aggregates when available. Example mapping we'll publish:

```npartner_sku,redwood_sku,unit,notes
edge-small,redwood.edge.small,seconds,convert to minutes for billing by rounding up
edge-pro,redwood.edge.pro,seconds,apply partner discount mapping
``n
jess-devex: sample replay command:

```bash
curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/partners/ingest \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d @edgesample.json
```

katie-sre: If `idempotency_key` missing we generate one and flag in logs so recon can identify synthesized keys.

marc-legal: Ping when effective date locked for amendment. Preserve audit trail for any invoice replacements.

ana-partnerships: I'll request sample data for last 30 days from partner and confirm canary device list. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
